pages.text: Earn $(bold)progression tokens$(), bank them to your tier's threshold, and the Codex advances you — automatically.$(br2)Four $(bold)lanes$() earn tokens — Engineering, Magic, Exploration, and Combat — and they all feed $(bold)one combined pool$(). No lane is mandatory: any single one, played on its own, can reach the threshold. Hybrids mix freely.

pages.title: The Four Lanes
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Engineering$() — submit bulk metals and milestone machines (Create, then Thermal, then Mekanism).$(li)$(bold)Magic$() — submit cultivation reagents and apparatus (Botania, Ars Nouveau, advanced rituals). Cultivation only, never spellcasting.$(li)$(bold)Exploration$() — tokens from entering new dimensions, looting chests, and kills.$(li)$(bold)Combat$() — tokens from boss and miniboss kills.$(br2)Pick the lane that fits how you play, or blend them.

pages.title: Two Routes per Tier
pages.text: Advance by reaching $(bold)either$() target — whichever comes first:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Tokens$() — bank the threshold: $(t2)500$() → T2, $(t3)1000$() → T3, $(t4)2000$() → T4.$(li)$(bold)Boss Rush$() — clear a share of the tier's bosses: $(t2)80%$() → T2, $(t3)90%$() → T3, $(t4)100%$() → T4.$(br2)Tier 4 is the final gate. Beyond it, the Ender Dragon is the finale — see $(l:icraft:progression/tier_unlock_checklist)Tier Targets$(/l).

pages.title: Submitting & Tracking
pages.text: The Codex converts your work into tokens and tracks your progress toward the next tier.$(br2)$(bold)To submit:$() run $(bold)/icraft codex submit$() — it scans your inventory and banks everything that counts (consuming those materials).$(br)$(bold)To check progress:$() run $(bold)/icraft codex balance$() — it shows your token total versus the threshold.$(br2)$(note)Tokens are physical items — Codex Token I, II, and III, one per tier transition.$()
